When the company announces a strict ban on office romance, a dedicated employee realizes her growing feelings for her direct manager could put both of their careers at risk. After a late-night elevator incident brings them unexpectedly close, they begin dating in secret, hiding their relationship behind professional distance, coded messages, and discreet meetings outside the office. As rumors spread and they are nearly caught together, her manager becomes colder in public to protect them, creating tension and doubt between them. Their worst fear comes true when HR launches an investigation following an anonymous report, forcing them to choose between their careers and their relationship. In the end, he decides to reveal the truth and request a transfer, accepting the professional consequences so they can finally be together without hiding.

Possible Characters:
Sophie: A careful and detailed office worker who is deeply in love with her manager, constantly trying to balance her career with her secret passion.
The Manager: A disciplined, restrained leader who lets his guard down only when alone with Sophie, desperately trying to protect her and their career.
HR Officer: A vigilant HR representative who strictly enforces the company's no-dating policy and watches employees closely.
Coworker: An overly curious colleague who frequently wanders the halls and almost catches Sophie and the Manager in their private moments.

§13.2（11/4 update，comment #247）Chat 捲動四種情境

1. user 送出訊息 → 這則訊息置頂（停在畫面最上方，下方不夠高時留空白），Iris 回覆在下面接著長；回覆超出畫面也不跟著捲，底部顯示 ↓。
2. 按 Generate（AI 做事）→ 按 Generate 也等於 user 送出一則訊息：送出 Answer 文字（DramaQuestionsAndAnswers 裡有 Answer 的，例：Create storyboard、Create characters、Update characters）→ 一樣讓這則訊息置頂。
3. user 滑動畫面 → 不動：停在 user 捲到的位置，不自動捲；新內容在畫面外顯示 ↓。點 ↓、捲回最底、或再送出／再按 Generate 後恢復 1、2 的規則。
4. user 從 recent task（History）進來，或從 Character Library／Full Edit／scene 編輯頁回到 chat → 保持最底（最新訊息）。

• 結果出來（skeleton 換成圖／影片）原地替換，不再捲動。
• ↓ 上不顯示未讀數字；樣式依 design spec。

HR Director clicks a remote, changing the presentation slide to a bold title: 'COMPANY CONDUCT POLICY'. The room is dead silent. HR：「Effective immediately, office relationships are strictly prohibited.」 Sophie sitting at the conference table, staring forward with a tense, frozen expression while pretending to take notes. HR：「Any violation will be treated as a disciplinary matter.」 Chloe leans over slightly, whispering behind her hand to Sophie who sits stiffly, eyes locked forward. Chloe：「Harsh. Who did they catch this time?」 Sophie answers quietly without turning her head, her hand tightly gripping her metallic pen. Sophie：「...No idea.」 The Manager sits two seats down, staring fixedly at the screen with a completely blank expression. The Manager：「Eyes on the slide, everyone.」 Sophie looks down at her tablet, her chest rising and falling as she swallows hard, feeling the weight of his cold demeanor. Sophie：「He didn't even look at me. Good. That's good.」

§13.28（11/4）Storyboard 多個 scene 失敗：先修第一個

• 分鏡圖或地點參考圖任一張失敗，都算這個 scene 失敗。
• 跳出時機：進入某個失敗 scene 的編輯頁，或用 ◀ ▶ 切到某個失敗 scene，而前面還有更早的失敗 scene。
• Dialog：
  Title：Fix Scene {n} first?
  Body：{count} scenes couldn't be created. Start with Scene {n}, since later scenes may use its images.
  Buttons：Not now ／ Go to Scene {n}（藍）
• Go to Scene {n}：切到最前面的失敗 scene。
• Not now：留在原 scene，照常編輯、重新生成；這次編輯中不再跳，下次進編輯頁才會再跳。
• 不跳：目前就是最前面的失敗 scene／只有一個 scene 失敗／最前面的失敗 scene 正在重新生成。
• 最前面的修好後，下一個失敗的 scene 變成新的「最前面」。
• 從 chat 錯誤訊息的 Edit 進來本來就停在第一個失敗的 scene（§13.7），不跳。
